title: Jolly Jamaican Maple Fritters
description: A sweet and crispy Jamaican treat featuring maple syrup, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This yeasty, light, and gluten-free-friendly dish is a delightful surprise.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the warm water and yeast, letting it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add the maple syrup, coconut sugar, gluten-free flour, and salt to the bowl, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours, or until doubled in size.
Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 12 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Fry the disks in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve them in scalloped shell vessels.
Drizzle the melted butter over the fritters and serve immediately.
